title: The Ancient Art of Kannauj Perfumery: Extracting Pure Oud
author: Dr. Aarav Mehta
excerpt: Discover how Kannauj, the perfume capital of India, continues to produce the world's most luxurious and long-lasting attars through hydro-distillation.
paragraphs: Nestled along the banks of the Ganges River, the ancient city of Kannauj has earned its title as the Grasse of the East. For over a thousand years, master craftsmen here have captured the scent of rain-soaked earth, royal agarwood, and fresh damask roses in copper pots called degs.

Unlike modern synthetic colognes, traditional Indian attars are concentrated perfume oils containing zero alcohol. They are distilled directly into a base of pure sandalwood oil or other premium carrier oils. This age-old hydro-distillation process ensures that the scent notes do not immediately evaporate but instead blend with the natural warmth of your skin.

At CEZLIAR, we source our Oud Majestic Attar directly from the master distillers of Kannauj. Wild-harvested agarwood is slow-cooked for days, releasing its precious resinous oil. The result is a scent that unfolds progressively over 12 hours, shifting from spicy warmth to a deep, royal woody finish.

Applying attar is a ritual. Rather than spraying from afar, you apply a single drop onto pulse points, rubbing gently. This warms the oil, allowing the molecules to slowly release their luxury aroma into your aura.

title: Why You Should Switch to Charcoal-Free Dhoop
author: Priya Sen
excerpt: Many commercial incense sticks release harmful carbon particulate matter. Learn how pure charcoal-free dhoop purifies the air without toxic smoke.
paragraphs: Incense has been a cornerstone of Indian homes and spiritual practices for millennia. However, in recent decades, mass manufacturing has introduced cheap charcoal, chemical binding agents, and synthetic fragrance oils into commercial incense sticks.

When burned, charcoal incense produces heavy black smoke rich in carbon monoxide and respiratory irritants. For households with children, elderly members, or pets, this smoke can compromise indoor air quality.

Switching to charcoal-free, organic dhoop is a simple way to protect your lungs while retaining the spiritual, calming benefit of aromatherapy. Pure dhoop is made by mixing natural wood powders (like sandalwood), dried flowers, honey, and pure essential oils into a paste.

Our CEZLIAR Sandalwood Premium Dhoop burns clean, releasing only a light, fragrant smoke that purifies the air rather than polluting it. The calming scent molecules from sandalwood trigger alpha waves in the brain, helping reduce anxiety and setting a perfect mood for meditation.

title: Safe and Effective Home Care: Dissolving Clogs Safely
author: Dr. Sanjay Nair
excerpt: Learn the science behind modern plumbing blockages and how to clear drains without damaging your pipes or inhaling toxic fumes.
paragraphs: Every household faces clogged drains at some point. The instinct is often to grab the strongest chemical opener available, pour it down, and hope for the best. Unfortunately, many traditional acid-based openers generate extreme heat that can melt PVC pipes and damage metal plumbing joints.
Additionally, the acidic vapors produced are dangerous to inhale, creating potential health risks during use.

To clear drains safely and effectively, look for alkaline-based gel openers. Alkaline solutions work by saponification: they chemically break down grease, hair, and soap scum, turning them into liquid compounds that wash away easily with water. Because they do not react violently with water, they do not heat up pipes to damaging levels.

The CEZLIAR Pro Drain Opener is formulated using concentrated alkaline gels. It dissolves organic blockages in 15 minutes, has zero harsh acidic fumes, and remains 100% safe on all PVC and metal piping. Always follow up a drain treatment with a flush of warm water to clear any loose residue.
